documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report — Drainage Engineering Review (DE 3)

findings.comment: Drainage easement documents for the 25-foot drainage easement and City of Austin drainage easement shown on the site plan have not been demonstrated as submitted to City Legal Department for review and approval prior to recordation. Drainage Engineering review comment DE 3 (Pending status) specifically requests 'Please provide the drainage easement document' indicating the document has not been provided.

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report — Water Quality Review (WQ 12)

findings.comment: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) restrictive covenant required for the biofiltration/detention pond has not been demonstrated as submitted to City Law Department for review and written approval prior to recordation. Water Quality review comment WQ 12 indicates the IPM plan is pending submission; no evidence of covenant submittal to City Law is provided.

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report — Water Quality Review (WQ 12)

findings.comment: IPM restrictive covenant in the form approved by City Law Department has not been provided. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains a blank document number field, and no covenant document with exhibits, lien search, affidavit, or consents has been submitted for review.

applicableAreas: cover sheet; IPM/maintenance covenant for detention pond

documentReferences.label: Master Comment Report — Water Quality Review (WQ 12)

findings.comment: Required legal instrument (IPM restrictive covenant for biofiltration pond) not properly identified and listed on site plan or in comment response letter. The cover sheet IPM note (Sheet 1, Block 12) contains the template text 'For Integrated Pest Management Plan, see agreement filed in document No.____________, Official Public Records, Travis County, Texas' but the document number field is blank, indicating the required legal instrument is not complete or identified.
